leaves.name: bfhClauseIIGamma0
leaves.doc: Bump-Friedberg-Hoffstein, Invent. Math. 102 (1990) 543-618, opening theorem (pp. 543-544), clause (ii), at weight k = 2 (centre s = k/2 = 1): for F a classical newform of weight 2 on Gamma_0(N) (IsGamma0Newform: F in S_2(Gamma_0(N)) an eigenform of Tau Ceti's Hecke operators T_n for (n, N) = 1, Petersson-orthogonal to V_d S_2(Gamma_0(M)) for dM | N, M != N, a_1(F) = 1), epsilon the sign of the functional equation of the completed L(s, F) at level N (IsFESignGamma0, over ZInQ.Literature.completedL), and S a finite set of primes containing the primes dividing N, there is a fundamental discriminant D != 1 (Int.IsFundamentalDiscr, Mathlib) with epsilon D > 0, every p in S split in Q(sqrt D) (SplitsInQuadratic), and L(1, F, chi_D) != 0 with chi_D(n) = (D/n) the Kronecker symbol (BFHPrinted.kroneckerSym), L(s, F, chi_D) = sum a_n(F) (D/n) n^(-s) read through its entire continuation (KroneckerCentralValueNeZeroGamma0)
leaves.flag: note: printed form, instance k = 2; the statement-check read of BFH Invent. Math. 102 pp. 543-544 rated every clause printed except the identification of Tau Ceti's Gamma_1(N)-newform of trivial nebentypus with the classical Gamma_0(N)-newform, and this leaf is stated over the classical Gamma_0(N)-newform (BFHPrinted.IsGamma0Newform), the identification being proved in Lean (isGamma0Newform_toCuspFormGamma0, IsGamma0Newform.toNewform; the leaf is equivalent to BFHClauseIIKronecker and BFHClauseII, bfhClauseIIGamma0_iff, bfhClauseIIGamma0_iff_bfhClauseII). The check's record is not on the bfh-gamma0 host: if it is not in the repository, use flag_class unread
